title: Refactor generation out of World.ts
description: I'd like to remove the world generation code from World.ts. There is no reason to have it there since it is only called once one startup and can be stored separately and we don't have to look at it unless we want to change generation. Create a separate class that has methods to generate a world. Then, remove the call to generateWorld in the World class constructor. Whatever function is creating the World is responsible for passing in the tiles[][] matrix. This will also simplify the test fixture implementation.

title: Add tens-digit to overworld CLI map
description: The overworld CLI map currently shows '0   5' at the top which is useful for navigation, but is missing the tens digit making it hard to use the 'move-to' command. Add the tens digit to the 0 and keep the current alignment. So, it would show '30    5    40' And the 0 and 5 would be aligned to the 30, 35, and 40th columns.
close_reason: Implemented tens-digit display in overworld CLI map. The column header now shows full numbers (e.g., '30', '40') at multiples of 10, with the ones digit aligned to the actual column position.

title: Refactor river generation out of River.ts
description: Similar to World.ts, extract the code that generates the river from River.ts and put it in a separate class. Whoever calls new River() is responsible for generating the river data itself and passing it in.
